description: This file declares the SetCaps class, which is a task related to setting capabilities (caps) for WebAudio in a media server context. It includes class definitions, constructor, destructor, and methods for creating caps from MIME type and setting bytes per sample, along with private member variables.

classes.name: SetCaps
classes.description: A class representing a task to set capabilities for WebAudio playback, implementing the IPlayerTask interface.

methods.name: SetCaps
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SetCaps task with context, wrappers, MIME type, and configuration.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the task to set capabilities.

methods.name: createCapsFromMimeType
methods.description: Creates GstCaps object based on the MIME type.

methods.name: setBytesPerSample
methods.description: Sets the number of bytes per audio sample.
